summary: You present a clear, well-written mission rationale for Great Barrier Reef monitoring and a readable, well-structured report. However, the technical design is weak: the 600 km GEO orbit is incorrect, no quantified requirements or preliminary technical results are given, and the plan lacks contingencies and a source list. Weighted score approximately 57/100.
next_steps: Correct the orbit: GEO is ~35,786 km and cannot stay fixed over the non-equatorial GBR; select and justify an appropriate orbit (e.g. LEO) and derive altitude, revisit and coverage.
Add quantified mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency) tied to user needs, and replace footnote URLs with formal citations including access dates.

Strengthen the plan with contingency/risk provision, an explicit information-source list, and reconcile Gantt dates with the text and 20/11 due date; include preliminary STK/technical results with interpretation.

criteria.C1: You clearly explain mission purpose, users and rationale with references. To reach Accomplished, quantify mission requirements—spatial resolution, revisit time, spectral bands, data latency—and tie each to user needs. Qualify bleaching mortality figures as mainly shallow-water northern GBR, not the whole reef. Replace footnote URLs with formal citations including access dates.
criteria.C2: Your Gantt chart and task breakdown make the plan credible. For Accomplished, add contingency/risk provision and an explicit list of planned information sources. Reconcile inconsistencies: text says editing Weeks 7–8 but chart shows Weeks 9–10; chart ends 16/11 while the final report is due 20/11. Explain plan choices in the context of the mission.
criteria.C3: You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research. To move from Adequate to Accomplished, present preliminary technical results—e.g. STK orbit/sensor outputs, coverage/revisit calculations, link or data-rate estimates—with brief interpretation showing you are on track. Currently no calculations or simulation outputs demonstrate design progress.
criteria.C4: Well-structured, readable and consistent; the Gantt is clear and labelled, and footnotes match in-text citations. To secure Accomplished, add a formal reference list and a figure caption for the Gantt chart. Minor formatting refinements only.
